bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'TARGET_UNIT\n';systemctl --user show gace-public-video-only-nippon-20261115.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p MainPID --no-pager
printf 'RESIDENT=';systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service
printf 'WRONG_SCOPE_UNITS\n';for u in gace-public-video-all-joined-retry-20261114.service gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service;do echo "$u=$(systemctl --user show "$u" -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null || echo not_loaded)";done
printf 'CURRENT_PROGRESS\n';cat /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/_jobs/thegreatolddaysofnippongv.json
printf '\nVIDEO_COUNT=';find /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/1877875443 -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name '*.partial' | wc -l
printf 'PARTIAL\n';find /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/1877875443 -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.partial' -printf '%f %s\n'
printf 'END\n'
